72172-title-fight.title: Title Fight
72172-title-fight.creator: Unknown
72172-title-fight.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It had been born in the verbiage of his daily syndicated sports column, nurtured by the fans' clamor, and fanned into reality--by what? These robots were coming up in the world, getting too big for their britches. Nick Nolan would show this Alix his place.

arxiv-2105-08973.creator: D. T. S. Perkins, G. M. Klemencic, J. M. Fellows, R. A. Smith

arxiv-2211-05079.title: Taylor dispersion and phase mixing in the non-cutoff Boltzmann equation on the whole space
arxiv-2211-05079.creator: Jacob Bedrossian, Michele Coti Zelati, Michele Dolce
arxiv-2211-05079.description: Abstract . In this paper we describe the long-time behavior of the non-cutoff Boltzmann equation with soft potentials near a global Maxwellian background on the whole space in the weakly collisional limit (i.e. infinite Knudsen number 1 / ν → ∞ 1/\nu\to\infty ).

arxiv-2401-03335.title: A remark on normal closures in free products of groups
arxiv-2401-03335.creator: Dali Zangurashvili
arxiv-2401-03335.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dali Zangurashvili. It is shown that a nontrivial normal subgroup N N of a group G G is a free factor of the N N ’s normal closure in the G G ’s free product with arbitrary nontrivial groups. Key words and phrases : free product of groups; normal closure of a subgroup; the subgroup theorem for free products of groups. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification : 20E06, 20E07; 20E15; 20J15.

arxiv-2409-18605.title: Growth of Massive Black-Holes in FFB Galaxies at Cosmic Dawn
arxiv-2409-18605.creator: Avishai Dekel 1,2 ,, Nicholas C. Stone 1, Dhruba Dutta Chowdhury 1, Shmuel Gilbaum 1, Zhaozhou Li 1, Nir Mandelker 1, Frank C. van den Bosch 3
arxiv-2409-18605.description: Abstract Aims. The scenario of feedback-free starbursts (FFB), which predicts excessively bright galaxies at cosmic dawn as observed using JWST, may provide a natural setting for black hole (BH) growth. This involves the formation of intermediate-mass seed BHs and their runaway mergers into super-massive BHs with high BH-to-stellar mass ratios and low AGN luminosities. Methods.

arxiv-2502-12920.title: Lightweight Online Adaption for Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts
arxiv-2502-12920.creator: Thomas L. Lee, William Toner, Rajkarn Singh, Artjom Joosen, Martin Asenov
arxiv-2502-12920.description: Abstract Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising approach for time series forecasting. While effective, FMs typically remain fixed during deployment due to the high computational costs of learning them online. Consequently, deployed FMs fail to adapt their forecasts to current data characteristics, despite the availability of online feedback from newly arriving data.

arxiv-2511-09865.title: In-Token Rationality Optimization: Towards Accurate and Concise LLM Reasoning via Self-Feedback
arxiv-2511-09865.creator: Mingye Zhu, Yi Liu, Zheren Fu, Quan Wang Yongdong Zhang
arxiv-2511-09865.description: Abstract Training Large Language Models (LLMs) for chain-of-thought reasoning presents a significant challenge: supervised fine-tuning on a single “golden” rationale hurts generalization as it penalizes equally valid alternatives, whereas reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards struggles with credit assignment and prohibitive computational cost.

arxiv-2511-19125.title: Noisy dynamics of confined quantum walks on a chip
arxiv-2511-19125.creator: L. Sansoni, E. Stefanutti, C. Benedetti, I. Gianani, C. Taballione, A. Toor, L. Herrera, M. Pistilli, S. Santoro, M. Barbieri, A. Chiuri
arxiv-2511-19125.description: Abstract Quantum walks represent an excellent testbed for investigating the interplay between unitary coherent and incoherent dissipative processes. Thanks to photonic quantum interferometers of considerable size, experimental studies could be performed, devoted to investigating the consequences of different sorts of realistic noise in these systems.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-conceptionist.creator: Michael Bihl
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-conceptionist.description: Article 'Conceptionists' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10533550.title: Embedded shape morphing for morphologically adaptive robots
pmc-10533550.creator: Jiefeng Sun, Elisha Lerner, Brandon Tighe, Clint Middlemist, Jianguo Zhao
pmc-10533550.description: Shape-morphing robots can change their morphology to fulfill different tasks in varying environments, but existing shape-morphing capability is not embedded in a robot’s body, requiring bulky supporting equipment. Here, we report an embedded shape-morphing scheme with the shape actuation, sensing, and locking, all embedded in a robot’s body.

pmc-10656987.title: Relationship between the shape of intracranial pressure pulse waveform and computed tomography characteristics in patients after traumatic brain injury
pmc-10656987.creator: Agnieszka Kazimierska, Agnieszka Uryga, Cyprian Mataczyński, Marek Czosnyka, Erhard W Lang, Magdalena Kasprowicz, CENTER-TBI high-resolution sub-study participants and investigators
pmc-10656987.description: BackgroundMidline shift and mass lesions may occur with traumatic brain injury (TBI) and are associated with higher mortality and morbidity. The shape of intracranial pressure (ICP) pulse waveform reflects the state of cerebrospinal pressure–volume compensation which may be disturbed by brain injury. We aimed to investigate the link between ICP pulse shape and pathological computed tomography (CT) features.

pmc-11360513.title: What the Paris 1924 olympics tell us about promoting oral health for community sport - a call to action
pmc-11360513.creator: Ian Needleman
pmc-11360513.description: Sport participation has huge benefits to individuals and communities including both physical health and wellbeing, prevention of non-communicable diseases, promoting equity and reducing inequalities. Sport participation can disadvantage oral health with a life-long shadow of treatment need and potential psycho-social consequences, despite these problems being preventable.

pmc-11508117.title: Cost Analysis of End-Stage Renal Disease in Pediatric Patients in Greece
pmc-11508117.creator: Christos Ntais, Konstantina Loizou, Costas Panagiotakis, Nikolaos Kontodimopoulos, John Fanourgiakis, Charat Thongprayoon
pmc-11508117.description: Background/Objectives: The cost resulting from peritoneal dialysis (PD), conventional hemodialysis (HD) and online hemodiafiltration (OL-HDF) in pediatric patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) has not been estimated to date in Greece. The present single-center retrospective study aimed to estimate the mean annual cost of the above methods, as well as the individual components of this cost.

pmc-11678982.title: A Novel Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearings Based on the ConvNeXt Network with Improved DenseBlock
pmc-11678982.creator: Jiahao Song, Xiaobo Nie, Chuang Wu, Naiwei Zheng
pmc-11678982.description: Rolling bearings are critical rotating components in machinery and equipment; they are essential for the normal operation of such systems. Consequently, there is a pressing need for a highly efficient, applicable, and reliable method for bearing fault diagnosis. Currently, one-dimensional data-driven fault diagnosis methods, which rely on one-dimensional data, represent a mainstream approach in this field.

pmc-11716505.title: Altered Effective Connectivity Patterns in Low‐Gamma Band for MCI Patients in a Motion Detection Task
pmc-11716505.creator: Alina Brighty Renli, Boxin Sun, Ming Gu, Jinxian Deng, Voyko Kavcic, Tongtong Li, Bruno Giordani, Michigan Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
pmc-11716505.description: BackgroundChanges in effective connectivity, which represents the directed connectivity or information flow from one brain region to the other, have been proposed to underlie mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) pathology. The present study explores possible differences in brain effective connectivity between persons with normal cognition (NC) and patients with MCI.

pmc-12390089.title: A Novel Multi-Core Parallel Current Differential Sensing Approach for Tethered UAV Power Cable Break Detection
pmc-12390089.creator: Ziqiao Chen, Zifeng Luo, Ziyan Wang, Zhou Huang, Yongkang He, Zhiheng Wen, Yuanjun Ding, Zhengwang Xu
pmc-12390089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Tethered unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in terrestrial environments face critical safety challenges from power cable breaks, yet existing solutions—including fiber optic sensing (cost > USD 20,000) and impedance analysis (35% payload increase)—suffer from high cost or heavy weight. This study proposes a dual innovation: a real-time break detection method and a low-cost multi-core parallel sensing system design based on ACS712 Hall sensors, achieving high detection accuracy (100% with zero false positives in tests).

pmc-12542628.title: Phenotype switching in highly invasive resistant to vemurafenib and cobimetinib melanoma cells
pmc-12542628.creator: Aleksandra Simiczyjew, Magdalena Kot, Michał Majkowski, Marcin Ziętek, Rafał Matkowski, Dorota Nowak
pmc-12542628.description: BackgroundA mutation in the BRAF (serine/threonine-protein kinase B-raf) gene is most often responsible for the progression of melanoma. A breakthrough in its treatment was the application of BRAF and MEK (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase) inhibitors. Unfortunately, the effectiveness of this therapy is limited due to rapidly emerging resistance to the drugs.

pmc-13221689.title: Financial Hardship and Nonadherence to Lifestyle and Surveillance in Childhood Cancer Survivors
pmc-13221689.creator: Neel S. Bhatt, Fang Wang, Shizue Izumi, Yan Chen, Timothy J. D. Ohlsen, Gregory T. Armstrong, I-Chan Huang, Anne Kirchhoff, Elyse R. Park, Claire Snyder, K. Robin Yabroff, Yutaka Yasui, Paul C. Nathan
pmc-13221689.description: Key PointsQuestionIs there an association between medical financial hardship and adherence to healthy behavior and recommended surveillance among adult survivors of childhood cancer?FindingsIn this cohort study of 3322 adults previously treated for a childhood cancer who were more than 3 decades from their diagnosis, more than one-half reported medical financial hardship.

pmc-13630665.title: Personalized management of platelet transfusion refractoriness: risk factors, cross-matching, and IVIG strategies
pmc-13630665.creator: Jixin Li, Linting Wang, Yi Qin, Yingyin Liang, Piao Lv, Yuan Yao, Xinxin Fan, Huayou Zhou
pmc-13630665.description: BackgroundPlatelet transfusion refractoriness (PTR) is a major clinical challenge in hematologic patients, yet real-world evidence comparing transfusion strategies—particularly the role of cross-matched platelets and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG)—remains limited.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 144 hematologic patients diagnosed with PTR at Nanfang Hospital (2019–2022), totalling 1,345 transfusion episodes. Patients were stratified by platelet antibody status.

uslaw-usc-t7-s3406.title: 7 U.S.C. § 3406 — Exemption for retail bakers
uslaw-usc-t7-s3406.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s3406.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 65 (Wheat And Wheat Foods Research And Nutrition Education). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Any end product manufacturer who is a retail baker shall be exempt from the provisions of this chapter. For the purposes of this section, the term “retail baker” shall be deemed to include all end product manufacturers who sell end products.
